scenes.speaker: Mira
scenes.headline: Too many possibilities
scenes.text: I keep collecting ideas, but none of them feels ready to begin.

scenes.speaker: Rowan
scenes.headline: Choose one small thing
scenes.text: Then let’s choose one small thing we can finish together, today.

scenes.speaker: Mira
scenes.headline: A light. A path. A first step.
scenes.text: Just one? A light, a path, and a first step?

scenes.speaker: Rowan
scenes.headline: Somewhere safe to start
scenes.text: Exactly. We don’t need the whole bridge. We need somewhere safe to start.
